 By : CNBCTV18.com November 7, 2026 | 14:31 IST Edited by Sudarsanan M 
 Published On Nov 7, 2026 | 14:31 IST 
 Last Updated On Nov 7, 2026 | 14:31 IST

(Image X@officialepfo) AI Summary Retirement fund subscribers can now securely track balances, review recent contributions, and download digital passbooks directly via WhatsApp through a newly launched multi-lingual chat service.
 + Follow on Google Add as preferred source Checking your Provident Fund (PF) balance has become easier, with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) introducing its services on WhatsApp. Members can now access important details related to their PF accounts without visiting the EPFO website or using an application.
 The service was launched on November 1, on the occasion of EPFO Foundation Day, by Union Minister for Labour and Employment Mansukh Mandaviya. In a post on X, EPFO announced the launch as another step towards making its digital services more accessible to members. 
 On occasion of EPFO Foundation Day, EPFO Services on WhatsApp were launched by Dr.
@mansukhmandviya
, Hon. Union Minister for Labour and Employment and Youth Affairs and Sports, marking another significant milestone in EPFO’s digital journey #EPFOat74 #EPFOServicesOnWhatsapp https://t.co/40YFLrswKF
— EPFO (@officialepfo) November 1, 2026 The new facility allows users to check their EPF balance, view their five most recent transactions and download their EPF passbook directly through WhatsApp. 
 Official number and features 
 EPFO has introduced a dedicated WhatsApp number, +91 8796441800, through which members can access their PF account information. Users can begin by sending a simple 'Hi' message to the number or scanning the QR code shared by EPFO.
 The service supports English and several Indian languages, including Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati and Urdu. Members are required to verify their identity using a one-time password (OTP) sent to the mobile number registered with their Universal Account Number (UAN).
 How to check EPF balance on WhatsApp: Step-by-step guide 
 1. Save the official EPFO WhatsApp number +91 8796441800 on your phone.
 2. Open WhatsApp and start a conversation with the saved contact.
 3. Send 'Hi' to begin using the service.
 4. Once you receive the welcome message, select your preferred language.
 5. Choose the 'Check Balance' option from the available menu.
 6. Enter the OTP received on your UAN-registered mobile number to verify your identity.
 7. Select the relevant PF account or Member ID if multiple accounts are linked to your UAN.
 8. After verification, your EPF balance details will appear in the WhatsApp conversation.
 How to download EPF passbook through WhatsApp 
 Members can also download their EPF passbook using the same WhatsApp service.
 1. Open the official EPFO WhatsApp chat.
 2. Send 'Hi' and select your preferred language if starting a new conversation.
 3. Choose the 'Download Passbook' option from the menu, or select it after viewing your PF balance.
 4. Complete OTP verification if prompted.
 5. Select the relevant PF account or Member ID.
 6. Download the passbook PDF provided in the conversation.
 How to check last five EPF transactions on WhatsApp 
 To view recent PF account activity, members can select the 'Last 5 Transactions' option from the WhatsApp service menu. After completing OTP verification, they need to choose the relevant PF account. The service will then display the five most recent transactions associated with that account.
 Members with multiple PF accounts should select the correct Member ID to access the required information.
 Important things to know 
 Members should use only EPFO's official WhatsApp number to access these services. They should also ensure that their mobile number is linked to their UAN, as OTP verification is required to retrieve account details.
 Users should never share their OTP, UAN password or other sensitive account information with anyone claiming to offer EPFO assistance.
